home.welcomeHeading: Economic research from Central Asia and the Caucasus
home.welcomeLede: A peer-reviewed, open-access journal published by the Economic Society of Uzbekistan. Every article is free to read and free to publish.
home.noPosts: No Weekly posts have been published yet.
home.aboutScope: We publish original empirical and theoretical research in economics, along with policy notes, review articles, and case studies.
home.aboutFocus: Our focus is the economies of Central Asia and the Caucasus: work on the region, work using data from the region, and comparative research that places it in a wider context.

home.submitLede: We accept proposals year-round. Send a title and an abstract and an editor will be in touch; there are no submission or publication fees.
